title: Mortality of 2×2 integer matrix semigroups
formal: Given a finite set of 2×2 matrices with integer entries, is it decidable whether a nonempty finite product of the matrices equals the zero matrix?
context:
The number of generators is unrestricted. Results for two generators, nonnegative entries or determinants restricted to 0 and ±1 do not settle the target.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: A minimal-dimensional undecidability frontier for matrix products and discrete dynamical systems.
